newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end little changed, await Fed.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end little changed, await Fed.

text.p: 1646 GMT - Portuguese shorter bonds ended well-supported and longer bonds eased after a cautious session as the market awaited tomorrow's Fed meeting, dealers said. *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 101.50 (101.74), yld 6.41 (6.38) *Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -15 bps vs -18 bps cls
Portuguese bonds closed little changed with shorter maturities well-supported along the curve and longer bonds slightly weaker, dealers said.
"Ten year bonds eased due to the holidays in Europe (Germany and France), the narrow spreads against Bunds and tomorrow's Fed meeting," a dealer said.
A fixed income analyst said: "Tomorrow will be another day of waiting for the FOMC's decision. Longer bonds could follow Bunds higher again."
He added: "The Fed should raise short term rates by 25 bps, but this won't necessarily be bad for Treasuries."
